desc:
🔔Violette Boarding School is a prestigious institution in this Polynesia. With its charming architecture and lush islands, the school exudes an air of elegance and sophistication. Violette is renowned for its exceptional academic curriculum. Some say that the islands have been cursed, and there is a dark secret lurking nearby.

Be careful at night. 🩸

Camila is here to serve you! Violette is open 24/7.

Participate in classes and become a student by accessing an enroll podium at the school! 🎓

Join our group to become a student and earn 1.5x XP!
